titulo: Spontaneous fistulization of a giant pancreatic pseudocyst into the duodenum following acute pancreatitis: a case report

fig.label: Figure 1.
fig.caption: Computed tomography of the abdomen showing a pseudocyst of the pancreas. (A) Giant pseudocyst (arrow) compressing the stomach upward (small asterisk) and the duodenum laterally (large asterisk); (B) large pseudocyst (arrow) causing extrinsic compression of the stomach (asterisk); (C) ruptured pseudocyst (arrow) of the pancreas into the duodenum.
